unchanged: the two reads (host, port) and the AcrylWeb type

changes.package: the adapter is its own plugin here (ACRYL keeps it in the engine seam), with the service provided inside an effect
changes.tests: ACRYL has no test for the adapter (its body is the two reads); tests/web.spec.ts pins the seam here
changes.contract: the service type comes from the ported acryl-control (its platform/web.ts): host and port only, as in ACRYL 37f4dd9c after spec 048 T008. An earlier revision of this port provided two registration delegates against a control port that had drifted; both were removed when control was re-ported at a1727e46.
changes.dependency: acryl-control is a devDependency: only its AcrylWeb type is imported, so an app does not install it

notes: ACRYL main (37f4dd9c) declares AcrylWeb as host and port only; the type is imported from acryl-control so the service is declared once.
